hypotheses.justification: The proof uses `hk2` only to show `hQnot : C.Q ∉ J.edgeSegment 0`. That fact follows from the chord's properness alone. Suppose `C.Q ∈ J.edgeSegment 0`. `J.edgeSegment 0` is by definition `segment ℝ (J.vertex 0) (J.vertex 1)`, so it is convex (`convex_segment`). It contains `C.P`, by `hP` and `left_mem_segment`. So `Convex.segment_subset` gives `segment ℝ C.P C.Q ⊆ J.edgeSegment 0`, and this edge is contained in `J.carrier` (`edgeSegment_subset_carrier`). Then `C.segment_inter_carrier` turns this into `segment ℝ C.P C.Q ⊆ {C.P, C.Q}`, which contradicts `C.interior_nonempty` (the midpoint is in the segment but is neither endpoint, because `C.ne`). The rest of the proof stays the same. So the theorem remains true without `hk2`. The degenerate cases k = 0 and k = 1 cannot happen under the remaining hypotheses: k = 0 gives P = Q, and k = 1 makes the chord an edge of the polygon. The same argument also removes `hk` and `hQ`, so each of the three can be deleted on its own, and all three together as well.

`hk` is used only inside the proof of `hQnot : C.Q ∉ J.edgeSegment 0` (to compute `ZMod.val`). `hQnot` can be proved without any index arithmetic. If `C.Q ∈ J.edgeSegment 0`, then `C.P` is also in it (from `hP`), and the edge is convex (`convex_segment`). So `Convex.segment_subset` gives `segment ℝ C.P C.Q ⊆ J.edgeSegment 0 ⊆ J.carrier`, and `C.segment_inter_carrier` then gives `segment ℝ C.P C.Q ⊆ {C.P, C.Q}`. This contradicts `C.interior_nonempty`. The rest of the proof does not change. The `let : Fact (1 < J.n)` line is also unnecessary, because `J.three_le` provides it anyway.

`hQ` is used only to prove `hQnot : C.Q ∉ J.edgeSegment 0`. For every proper chord this holds whenever `C.P ∈ J.edgeSegment 0`, which follows from `hP`. If `C.Q` were also on that edge, convexity of the segment (`convex_segment`, `Convex.segment_subset`) would give `segment ℝ C.P C.Q ⊆ J.edgeSegment 0 ⊆ J.carrier`. By `C.segment_inter_carrier` this segment would then be contained in `{C.P, C.Q}`, contradicting `C.interior_nonempty` (which relies on `C.ne`). The rest of the proof (`segment_inter_carrier`, `segment_symm`, and `hPmem` from `hP`) does not use `hQ`. Note that `hP` itself is needed, because the conclusion requires `C.P ∈ J.edgeSegment 0`.
